summary: The focused array printing claim does not require maintenance. Every parser-produced array depth accepted by the source remains printable under the new depth guard.

assessment.necessity_reason: The harness prints only the tree returned by parsing. Parsing and printing start at depth zero, and array and object parsing reject containers at the same limit used by the new array printer.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at any nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes its parsed tree to a print function.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing dispatches array and object input to their respective container parsers.
Array parsing rejects a container at the nesting limit.
Object parsing applies the same limit to mixed nesting.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at any nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
after.reason: The new array print guard uses the same pre-increment depth limit as both container parsers. The harness's print paths initialize depth to zero.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing dispatches array and object input to their respective container parsers.
Array parsing rejects a container at the printer's threshold.
Object parsing applies that threshold to mixed nesting.
Unbuffered printing initializes its depth to zero.
Buffered printing also initializes its depth to zero.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same harness prints a parser-returned tree. The new array guard cannot reject an array at a depth the parser accepts. Coverage is limited to the focused claim.
